description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Amendments made to the service Minute of Sri Lanka Technological Service published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1930/12 of 01.09.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technological Service, specifically addressing training period regulations for public service recruitment. The content deals with public service administration, recruitment procedures, and requires approval from the Public Service Commission, which falls under public sector services and administration rather than government structure/personnel changes.
